about: Generated by papers/p1/hf-collect.mjs from atom/tools/hftable.mjs rank (runner runs hf-table-1, hf-lanth-1, hf-wide-1, hf-climb-1; later runs override earlier ones element by element); do not edit. lda: the local-exchange ground configuration (Hund-corrected); hf: Hartree–Fock's (js/hf.js, max-spin average plus the full term correction) over the local-exchange search's settled candidates within its window and, where climbed, Hartree–Fock's own one-electron neighbourhood. summary.fRow: the f row's verdicts against the lanthanide calibration B.
